subject: Implementing switch case to print different types of output using Shiny

messages.author: 68b5eaaa42a157df
messages.subject: Implementing switch case to print different types of output using Shiny
parts:
Hi,

I have got 3 different outputs to print on the screen using Shiny. The outputs have been combined to a vector using Switch Case and are as follows:
1. Table
2. Vector consisting of 'n' items
3. Vector consisting of 'n' items.

Following is the code used by me in Server.R. Can anyone advise what should i use to Print this in the correct format. i.e. 1 output below the other. I have used renderText  to print the complete output and following is a part of the code used inside renderText function:

output$result <- renderText({
    switch(input$resMethod, 
           "alpha" = {
             ...........................
             ...........................
x <- SubsetByCode(dataset(),"1111")
             y <- DetectOutlier1(x)
             z <- DetectOutlier2(x)
             res <- c(x,y,z)
           }, 
           stop ("No value")
    )
    return (res)

Below is the UI.R code used for the corresponding output:
tabPanel("Result", textOutput("resultMethod"), tableOutput("result"))

Right now I am getting the output as CSV (running text, even the table) but I want the 3 outputs to be printed in separate lines. Also, I want the 1st output to be printed as a table since it is a subset of a data table taken from a CSV file. I have also attached the output below for reference.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Implementing switch case to print different types of output using Shiny
parts:
If I'm understanding you correctly, you have three different outputs, and would like to only show one at a time, based on what is selected in the "resMethod" selectInput.

I would create three separate outputs, each wrapped with conditionalPanel that tests "input.resMethod == 'alpha'" (where 'alpha' is changed to be the appropriate value for each type).

Joe, 

That is not what I wanted to implement. I have found the solution to it.

The problem was like this:

Switch{
case1: (table output1, text Output1, text Output2)
case2: (text Output3, plot Output1, table Output2, etc.)
case3: (similar to above)
and so on.....

}
